news.title: Global Banks Score 32% on Strategy’s Bitcoin Adoption Index: Fidelity Leads at 71%
news.body: Strategy's Bitcoin Banking Adoption Index rates 25 major banks at 32% overall, with Fidelity leading at 71% and US peers far ahead of Europe and Asia. The post Global Banks Score 32% on Strategy’s Bitcoin Adoption Index: Fidelity Leads at 71% appeared first on 99Bitcoins.
news.title_ru: Глобальные банки набирают 32% по индексу принятия биткойнов Стратегии: Fidelity лидирует с 71%

news.title: Ripple Backs Britain’s Tokenization Push: Did Brad Garlinghouse Just Save XRP?
news.body: Ripple has joined the UK Treasury's wholesale digital markets taskforce, targeting a £33B economy boost — months after nearly shutting down over the SEC lawsuit. The post Ripple Backs Britain’s Tokenization Push: Did Brad Garlinghouse Just Save XRP? appeared first on 99Bitcoins.
news.title_ru: Ripple поддерживает британскую инициативу по токенизации: Брэд Гарлингхаус только что спас XRP?
